{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify the presence of QA orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Filter for new customers reached by paid search
target_group = sales[(sales['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (sales['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Compute total and converted counts
total_new_paid_search = len(target_group)
converted_new_paid_search = len(target_group[target_group['converted'] == 1])

# Compute conversion rate
conversion_rate = converted_new_paid_search / total_new_paid_search

# Print all required numbers explicitly
print(f"Total new customers reached by paid search: {total_new_paid_search}")
print(f"Converted new customers reached by paid search: {converted_new_paid_search}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")

# Return the fraction
conversion_rate"}
